title: A proof run is at one clean commit
statement: A proof run MUST name exactly one full commit, and every test outcome in it MUST come from a run against that commit's tree with no uncommitted change.

title: Every automated test has an outcome
statement: A proof run MUST hold a test outcome for every test record whose state is automated in the spec at its commit; a test that did not run is recorded as failed with the detail did not run, never left out.

title: An outcome names a test record that exists
statement: Every test outcome MUST name a test record that exists in the spec at the run's commit, and a proof run with an outcome for an unknown ID is refused, so a test named by a wrong ID is fixed and never silently ignored.

title: The provider's trusted signer attests the run
statement: A proof run MUST be attested by the trusted signer of the CI provider that ran it, with the commit as the attestation's subject, and a proof run without a verified attestation is no evidence.

title: The attestation store is the only home
statement: A proof run MUST NOT be written as a file in the product's repository; its only record is the attestation the provider keeps.

title: One outcome per test record
statement: A proof run MUST hold at most one outcome per test record; when a test record's ID runs more than once, the outcome is failed if any run failed, else skipped if any was skipped, else passed.

title: A change decision names both commits
statement: A change decision MUST name the change's commit and the base branch head it was gated against, with the coverage of both, and a release decision names only its commit.

title: A refusal names every cause
statement: A refused decision MUST name each obligation that fell from designed, built or proved and each test record that did not pass, and a passed decision names no reason.

title: A release decision is attested
statement: A passed release decision MUST be attested by the provider's trusted signer with the release commit as its subject, so release qualification can verify it without trusting the workflow that produced it.

title: The same commits give the same decision
statement: Gating the same commit against the same base with the same proof run MUST give the same decision and the same reasons, in the same order.

title: Module files change only after resolution passes
statement: Resolution MUST change go.mod and go.sum only after it and its checks succeed, through the apply journal, so a failed or interrupted resolution leaves both as they were.

title: Resolution reads only the captured source
statement: Resolution MUST resolve the source STEGO captured, and MUST ignore any Go setting that could change it, such as a saved -overlay flag.

title: A cache holds only modules that match go.sum
statement: A module cache MUST hold only module zips whose hashes go.sum states, and its record MUST list each by path, version and hash.

title: A build runs offline from a recorded cache
statement: A build MUST run with the network off, from a module cache whose inventory its record names, and MUST fail when a module is missing or does not match go.sum.

title: A build uses the archetype's Go SDK
statement: A build MUST use the Go SDK that the service's archetype pins, checked by the digest of its contents, and MUST refuse any other.

title: The same inputs give the same bytes
statement: Two builds from the same source revision, Go SDK and module cache MUST produce byte-identical executables, records and SBOMs.

title: The record names every input
statement: A build record MUST name the source revision, the Go SDK, the module cache inventory, the generation record, the digests of the executable and of every input, and the fixed build settings: CGO off, no workspace, no automatic toolchain switch, no automatic PGO, no telemetry, no source stamping, read-only modules and trimmed paths, with no setting or cache taken from the caller. It MUST NOT hold a credential or a complete environment.

title: An image comes only from a trusted build
statement: An image MUST hold only an executable whose digest a trusted build record names, on a scratch base, with an explicit CA bundle whose digest is trusted and never the host's, whether stego image build made it or a CI provider built it from the generated Containerfile.

title: An image carries both SBOMs
statement: Every image MUST carry an SPDX and a CycloneDX SBOM, both written from its build record and attached as signed attestations.

title: Only the pipeline's trusted signer signs
statement: An image signature MUST be made by the trusted signer that the service's delivery pipeline names for the provider that built the image, and verification MUST refuse any other identity; which signer a provider has, and that it comes from the registry, is Delivering's rule (ST-DLV-INV04).

title: The same build gives the same image
statement: Two runs of stego image build from the same build record, executable and CA bundle MUST produce the same image digest.

title: The source snapshot is the Git tree of the revision
statement: A build's source snapshot MUST equal the Git tree of the revision in every path, content and executable bit, and MUST refuse a link, a special file, a submodule, a path escape, an oversized input or an export attribute that changes or omits an input.

title: Image verification is exact
statement: Image verification MUST refuse an image that holds anything beyond the recorded executable and trust bundle in the recorded layout: an extra file, a link, a device, a changed owner or mode, unknown metadata, a changed hash or an excessive size, even when its hashes are consistent.

title: Registry transport is bounded and fails closed
statement: Every registry connection, loopback included, MUST use verified HTTPS under the operator's CA bundle; token and blob origins MUST be approved explicitly, at most eight each, a blob request MUST carry no credential or body, request counts, bytes, connections and time MUST be bounded, and no error MUST carry a credential, a token response or a redirect query.

title: A result folder is new, and a partial result is not a result
statement: A build, an image build and an SDK preparation MUST each start in a new work folder and write to a new result folder outside the input repository, MUST never reuse an interrupted folder, and MUST leave no result when they fail.

title: Exactly one archetype
statement: A declaration MUST select exactly one archetype.

title: No undeclared field
statement: A declaration MUST NOT carry a field that STEGO, the selected archetype or its components do not declare.

title: One document, no indirection
statement: A declaration MUST be one YAML document, and MUST NOT use anchors, aliases or merge keys.

title: Bounded input
statement: A declaration MUST NOT be larger than 4 MiB, and MUST NOT nest more than 128 levels deep.

title: Entity names are unique
statement: Every entity name MUST be unique within the declaration.

title: Field names are unique in their entity
statement: Every field name MUST be unique within its entity.

title: Constraints suit the type
statement: A field's constraints MUST suit the type the field declares.

title: Collection names are unique
statement: Every collection name MUST be unique within the declaration.

title: A collection reads a declared entity
statement: A collection MUST name an entity that the same declaration declares.

title: A binding names a declared collection and slot
statement: A slot binding MUST name a collection the declaration declares, and a slot that a component of the active component set declares.

title: A bound slot is invoked
statement: A slot binding MUST name a slot that a generator in the build invokes, so a binding cannot compile without ever running.

title: A setting matches its component schema
statement: A component setting MUST name a component of the active component set and a setting that component's schema declares, and its value MUST suit the declared type.

title: A default suits the type
statement: A field's default MUST suit the type the field declares.

title: An experiment is accepted by name
statement: A declaration MUST NOT use a component whose stage is not ga unless it accepts that component by name, with a reason and a date.

title: An acceptance cannot outlive the component
statement: An acceptance date MUST NOT be later than the sunset date of the component it accepts.

title: An acceptance expires
statement: A declaration MUST NOT be accepted after the date of any acceptance it holds.

title: The output folder and each factory package are import paths outside the output
statement: A declaration's output folder and each application factory package MUST be valid Go import paths, and a factory package MUST NOT lie inside the output folder.

title: Tenancy and audit are defaults
statement: A declaration that omits tenancy MUST get pooled tenancy, and one that omits audit MUST get audit at level change. A declaration that says tenancy kind single or audit off MUST give a reason. Checking MUST refuse one that gives none.

title: The tenant comes from a verified claim
statement: The tenancy claim MUST name a path in the verified identity token. Checking MUST refuse a tenancy claim taken from a client header or a body field.

title: No tenant-less path
statement: A controller MUST declare tenants each. A collection MUST NOT read an entity whose tenant is system. A binding that writes a shared entity MUST run as system. Checking MUST refuse tenants none, a collection over a system entity, and a tenant binding that writes a shared entity.

title: Audit values and sensitivity are known
statement: An audit level MUST be metadata or change. An audit sink MUST be a port binding of the declaration. A field sensitivity MUST be public, pii or secret. Audit annotations MUST be a string map. Checking MUST refuse any other value.

title: The schema holds every name the declaration uses
statement: Checking MUST compile the .zed schema. Checking MUST refuse a declaration that names a resource type, a permission, a relation or a caveat parameter the schema lacks.

title: A slot binding writes only declared relationships
statement: Each relation in Relationships written MUST exist in the schema and MUST belong to the resource type of an entity the service declares. Checking MUST refuse a relation that does not.

title: No bypass flag
statement: A slot or a setting MUST NOT hold a bypass flag. Checking MUST refuse one. A system principal MUST be a service-account subject the schema grants relations to.

title: Idempotency applies to create and update
statement: Required on MUST include create, and MAY name update or a custom operation served by POST or PATCH. Checking MUST refuse read, list or delete there, because GET, PUT and DELETE ignore the key.

title: Money is integer minor units in one currency
statement: A money field MUST be integer minor units with an ISO 4217 currency. A ledger MUST hold one currency. Each account MUST state a normal balance of debit or credit. Checking MUST refuse a float money field and a currency that is not an ISO 4217 code.

title: A ledger is append-only
statement: A collection over a ledger MUST allow only create, post, void, reverse, read and list. A slot MUST NOT update a balance column. A transfer MUST have at least two entries. A pending transfer MUST NOT change; it is voided and pended again. Checking MUST refuse update or delete on a ledger collection, a balance column a slot can update, and a transfer with one entry.

title: Modes and mixins are known
statement: Modes MUST be a subset of api, worker and controller; omitted means all. kafka-events MUST be bound together with durable-events. event-publisher MUST be accepted as a deprecated alias, with a warning. Checking MUST refuse an unknown mode and kafka-events without durable-events.

title: A controller holds a lease and iterates tenants
statement: A controller MUST declare its sources from scan and watch, a resync, its replicas and a lease TTL, and MUST run under a lease row with a fencing token. Checking MUST refuse a controller with no lease TTL or an unknown source.

title: A declared invariant has one known emission
statement: A declared invariant MUST be unique with on and by, no_overlap with on, range and by, or sum_limit with on and parent. Checking MUST refuse any other kind and a kind that lacks its fields. A rule with no known emission MUST stay a slot.

title: Authorization fails closed
statement: When the declaration binds authorization, every entity a collection reads MUST declare a resource type, and every operation of every collection MUST name a permission of that type or public with a reason. Checking MUST refuse a declaration with an entity or an operation left out, naming each; an operation is never unprotected by omission.

title: One successor, of the same component or of the one that took over its port
statement: A component digest MUST have at most one successor. The successor MUST be another digest of the same component, or a digest of the component that graduated to ga and took over the port the superseded component provided; in the second case the supersession MUST say that it needs a declaration change.

title: An installation replaces nothing
statement: An installation MUST refuse a result folder that already exists, and MUST NOT change what that folder holds.

title: A failed check leaves no installation
statement: When a digest check or a signature check fails, the installer MUST leave no result folder and no temporary download.

title: A compiler artifact exists only when two isolated builds agree
statement: A compiler artifact MUST be produced only when two builds from one commit in separate trees, homes and caches give byte-identical executables, module checksums and version records; a disagreement produces no artifact.

title: A release is one immutable tag per commit with four assets
statement: A compiler release MUST be published under the tag of its full commit, immutable, holding exactly the executable, its build record, SHA256SUMS and the signature bundle; a release or a tag MUST never be replaced, and a burned tag MUST be followed by a new commit and a new qualification.

title: Only the main-branch signing job signs, and only the bytes it fetched
statement: A compiler signature MUST come only from the signing job of a successful build of the pinned workflow at refs/heads/main, whether a push or a dispatch of that branch started the run, which holds the only attestation permission, fetches the build's artifact by its immutable ID, and signs only after both digests match the build job's outputs.

title: A supersession's fail date follows the stage window
statement: A supersession's fail date MUST equal the successor's release date plus the window the registry states for the component's stage, alpha 0 months, beta 3 months, ga 6 months, doubled when taking the successor needs a declaration change, unless a platform engineer shortens it; a fail date MUST NOT be later than that.

title: Every need is stated
statement: Platform requirements MUST state, with its kind and shape, every secret, configuration value, backing service, ingress, egress endpoint, cluster permission and pod security level that the service's components need.

title: Requirements hold no environment values
statement: Platform requirements MUST name needs only, and MUST NOT hold a secret value, a host name, an address, a namespace or any other value that differs per environment.

title: The CI file is one pinned call
statement: A delivery pipeline MUST hold only a call to its provider's shared pipeline and to the STEGO checks, each by a pinned reference, so that a change to the pipeline is a change to a pin.

title: The pins come from the registry
statement: A delivery pipeline's pinned references and trusted signer MUST come from the registry's ci-pipeline component, so one registry change and a regeneration move a service to a patched pipeline.

title: Every provider runs every STEGO check
statement: A candidate MUST pass every STEGO check (drift, vet, test, a reproducible stego build, and the executable match) before its provider releases it for delivery, whichever provider built it.

title: A candidate holds the recorded executable
statement: A candidate's executable MUST be byte-identical to the executable its stego build record names, including an image the Konflux standard pipeline built from the generated Containerfile.

title: The Containerfile builds offline
statement: The generated Containerfile MUST build on scratch with the network off, from prefetched modules that match go.sum, with the archetype's Go SDK and the settings stego build uses.

title: The base holds only what service.yaml derives
statement: A Kubernetes base MUST hold only resources derivable from service.yaml, with probes from health-check and default resource requests and limits, and MUST NOT set replicas, a PodDisruptionBudget, a namespace, an image digest, a host name, an egress address or a secret value.

title: The base needs no plugin
statement: A Kubernetes base MUST build with plain kustomize, with no plugin, generator program or remote base, so any GitOps tool reads it as it is.

title: The delivery object holds no environment values
statement: A delivery object MUST name the service, its project and its base, and MUST take its destination cluster, namespace and overlay from the platform's environment files its generator lists, never from service.yaml.

title: A fill implements one slot
statement: A fill MUST name exactly one slot of a component in the active registry, and one collection of the declaration.

title: Evidence names what it was taken against
statement: Test evidence MUST name the fill's content digest and its slot contract's digest as they were when the tests passed.

title: A sign-off signs one evidence
statement: A sign-off MUST carry a signature over the digest of the evidence it signs. When the evidence changes, the old sign-off no longer signs it.

title: A fill carries tests
statement: A fill MUST hold at least one test file. STEGO MUST record no evidence for a fill with none.

title: A fill imports only what it may
statement: A fill's code MUST import only its slot's contract package, the Go standard library and the modules the declaration lists for fills. STEGO MUST record no evidence for a fill that imports anything else.

title: Output and record change as one
statement: The generated files and the record MUST change as one unit. An apply that stops part way MUST leave a journal, and plan, apply and drift MUST refuse to run until recovery completes it.

title: The input manifest agrees with its record
statement: The input manifest in a record MUST name the same declaration digest and registry reference as the record itself, and STEGO MUST refuse a record where they differ.

title: The record names the registry content that produced it
statement: The registry content digest in a record MUST be the digest of the registry content that apply read. Apply MUST refuse a plan that carries another digest, and MUST write nothing.

title: The record names the compiler that produced it
statement: The compiler build in a record MUST be the build identity of the compiler that ran the apply. Apply MUST refuse a plan that carries another, and MUST leave the record unchanged.

title: The record describes the inputs as apply found them
statement: Apply MUST refuse a plan, saved or made in the same run, when a project input, the record or a generated file changed after planning, and MUST write neither files nor the record. So a saved plan applies only to the record it was planned against, and only once.

title: Each planned path has one owner
statement: A plan MUST give each output path to exactly one generator, slot or the assembler. Planning MUST stop on a path that two of them write, and MUST save no plan.

title: A generator writes only inside its namespace
statement: Planning MUST stop when a generator returns a file outside the output namespace its component declares, or when a component that generates files declares no namespace.

title: A plan never touches hand-written code
statement: A plan MUST NOT create, change or delete a file outside the output folder, except the project files that STEGO owns, so a fill and its tests are never written by a run.

title: A failed run writes nothing
statement: When validation, a generator or the assembler fails, STEGO MUST write no generated file, no record and no saved plan.

title: Only qualified fills that fit their binding are wired
statement: Plan and apply MUST stop, and write nothing, when a fill the declaration binds is not qualified or does not fit its binding, as Extending's qualification of each bound fill reports it.

title: The architecture view comes from the run's inputs alone
statement: The architecture view MUST be derived only from the declaration, the registry parts and the wiring of the same run, and MUST NOT take any hand-written description, network data or guess.

title: The architecture view changes with the code
statement: Every run that writes generated code MUST write the architecture view with it, recorded like any generated file, so a view that no longer matches its inputs is drift.

title: The module file holds the archetype's runtime pin and no other STEGO module
statement: A generated service's go.mod MUST require the runtime library at exactly the version and go.sum hash its archetype pins, and MUST require no other STEGO module and no replace directive for it; a hand edit of that line is drift.

title: A generated service binds its declaration at build time
statement: Nothing in a generated service MAY read the declaration, scan the binary, or register code by name, struct tag or init() to decide what runs. The service's own generated code MUST construct and wire every part in a fixed order, so the declaration is bound when the code is generated and never at startup or per request.

title: Apply refuses a pin that does not stand unless overridden
statement: Plan and apply MUST stop, and write nothing, when a pinned component digest or runtime version is withdrawn, or superseded past its fail date, as Distributing's standing reports it, unless the author overrides that pin by name on the command; the record MUST then name each overridden pin, and a lifecycle that cannot be read is not a pass.

title: A failed process writes one private failure record
statement: An assembled service that fails MUST write exactly one failure record to its error output, with a fixed stage name from the generated set and no formatted cause, panic value or stack, in one write attempt bounded by one second.

title: Every task shares one cancellation and ends before cleanup
statement: An assembled service MUST create one signal context before it constructs resources, MUST cancel every task on a signal or a task failure, MUST classify a return under cancellation as shutdown, and MUST wait for every task before deferred cleanup runs.

title: A task abort is contained
statement: When a task panics, also with a nil value or in a deferred call, or exits with Goexit, the assembled supervisor MUST stop and join its peers, MUST report the failed tasks by sorted name only, and MUST NOT let the panic value into any output.

title: Wiring is checked at assembly
statement: A background task MUST be a constructed value with a Run method whose constructor and dependencies the assembler retains, a constructor resource MUST be the service context or the selected database connection, every constructor index in the wiring (resources, tasks, error results, collections, dependencies, cleanup, primary, inner and outer middleware) MUST resolve, at most one component MUST declare primary middleware and no wrapper MUST lack a constructor, and a wiring that breaks any of these MUST fail generation with no file, never startup.

title: Every component's input check finishes before any component renders
statement: A run MUST finish every active component's input check before any component renders, and a failure in a later component MUST stop the run before rendering, so no file is written for a declaration any component refuses.

title: A constructor dependency names exactly one producer
statement: A constructor dependency MUST resolve to exactly one producer across the assembled components, by explicit metadata or by a value reference in a constructor argument; two producers of one name MUST make assembly refuse, naming the consumer, the dependency and the producers in sorted order.

title: The build target meets every active component's minimum Go version
statement: The service's Go build target MUST be at or above the minimum Go version each active component declares, checked before any generator runs; a component declares the minimum its pinned dependencies and language features need, and an unrelated component inherits no minimum.

title: The input manifest is bounded, canonical and digested one way
statement: The record's input manifest MUST list at most 1024 files by canonical relative path, MUST never list generated output or private state as an input, MUST exclude absolute paths so a moved project keeps its identity, MUST be checked against the loader's 4 MiB limit before it is saved, and its digest MUST be computed by one fixed codec.

title: A generated symbol never shadows a predeclared or startup name
statement: An import alias or a constructor's derived name in generated code MUST NOT be a Go predeclared identifier or a startup name such as main or run; the alias allocator MUST give such a path a distinct alias, and imports and fill construction MUST share one binding record.

title: A record is upgraded on the next run and decoded strictly
statement: A record written by an older compiler MUST be accepted and completed on the next apply, a change of the compiler's own identity MUST be a record change even when no output changes, and a record with an unknown field or version MUST be refused.

title: The assembler wires modes as component sets in one binary
statement: The assembler MUST wire each declared mode as a named component set registered with the mode registry of the runtime, MUST emit one entry point that selects modes by a repeatable mode flag with all as the default, and MUST NOT emit a fixed bundle or a second binary.

title: Generated concern checks are outputs a run must pass
statement: A run that emits tenant isolation, authorization, idempotency or ledger code MUST emit the isolation, authorization, idempotency and ledger checks as generated files, and the run MUST pass them before it writes the record.

title: A local registry adds and never replaces
statement: A local registry MUST NOT replace a part that the common registry supplies, and MAY only add parts of its own.

title: A component writes only its own namespace
statement: A component MUST write its output only into the namespace it declares, so one component cannot overwrite another's output.

title: An experiment owns only its own port
statement: A component whose stage is not ga MUST NOT provide a port that a ga component provides, so no override can put an experiment on a golden path.

title: A mixin adds and never replaces
statement: A mixin MUST only add components and slots to the archetype it extends, and MUST NOT replace a part of it.

title: Providers of one port agree on every field
statement: Two components that provide the same port MUST put the same meaning in every field of that port, so an override cannot change what a field means.

title: A declared slot is invoked
statement: A generator in the build MUST invoke every slot that its component declares, so a declared extension point cannot be dead.

title: A ga component meets the quality bar at its digest
statement: A component MUST be ga only while it holds a security review, a benchmark against a reference and a design review, each recorded at its current digest, and a reference comparison recorded at the current digest of its contract set. A new version of a ga component MUST meet the bar again before it is released as ga.

title: An archetype pins one Go SDK
statement: An archetype MUST pin one official Go SDK by version and contents digest, so every service on its golden path builds with the same toolchain, and a toolchain change is one registry change.

title: A component states its place in the architecture
statement: A component MUST state its layer, the part it plays in a request flow, and the side of the flow each of its ports is on, so the architecture view of every service that uses it is derived from the registry and never guessed from its generator.

title: An archetype pins one runtime library
statement: An archetype MUST pin exactly one runtime library version, by module path, version and go.sum hash, and every service of the archetype MUST import that version and no other STEGO module; only a new archetype version moves the pin.

title: A slot exposes a typed contract, never a framework handle
statement: A slot's contract MUST be the protobuf service it declares, and the code a component emits for the slot MUST NOT hand a fill a database handle, an ORM, a router or any other object through which the fill could step around the generated checks.

title: A component emits no static file
statement: Every file a component emits MUST vary with the declaration. A file that is byte-identical for two declarations that differ in everything the component reads, once the module path and package name are normalised, is static: it belongs in the runtime library, and the registry MUST refuse the component.

title: Every namespace is a Go import path
statement: A component's namespace MUST be a valid Go import path, a library namespace MUST end in a valid package name that is no keyword, blank or main, and both MUST be checked before rendering and never rewritten.

title: A slot contract changes only within Buf's FILE rules
statement: A change to a slot's contract under the same slot name MUST pass Buf's FILE breaking rule set against the contract last released, so every fill built against an earlier contract keeps compiling; a change that fails a FILE rule MUST take a new slot name.

title: A ga archetype carries tenancy and audit-log
statement: Every ga archetype MUST name the tenancy and the audit-log components as default concerns. A declaration MAY opt out of a default concern only with a reason, and the registry MUST record the reason.

title: A mixin may require another mixin
statement: A mixin MAY require another mixin. Checking MUST refuse a declaration that binds a mixin without a mixin it requires, naming both.

title: event-publisher is a deprecated alias
statement: The mixin event-publisher MUST resolve to durable-events plus kafka-events, MUST carry a sunset one ga window after the release that deprecated it, and a declaration that binds it MUST get a notice that names the two mixins and the sunset date.

title: A conformance suite includes the port's correctness tests
statement: A port's conformance suite MUST include the port's correctness tests, and the suite of authz-decision MUST include the new-enemy test.

title: The transactional-service archetype is curated once
statement: The transactional-service archetype MUST be rest-crud plus the durable-events mixin, the controller component, the spicedb-authz and idempotency mixins and the ledger entity kind, curated once in the common registry, and a local registry MUST NOT redefine it.

title: A provider that cannot check the fencing token runs one controller
statement: A component whose provider cannot refuse a write that carries a fencing token lower than the lease holds MUST declare it, and a controller on that provider MUST run one replica and MUST NOT take over an expired lease; a replica count, a lease expiry or an operator action alone is never proof of ownership (decided 2026-10-31, ST-SUP-Q01).
